entity_info.name: Apple Inc.
entity_info.description: Apple-specific concept mappings to handle unique XBRL taxonomy variations and period-specific concept changes

concept_mappings._comment_aapl_revenue: AAPL changed revenue concepts: 'Revenues' (2007-2017) -> 'RevenueFromContractWithCustomer' (2018+). Period-aware resolution handles this.
concept_mappings._comment_aapl_interest: AAPL has large cash holdings leading to significant Interest Income. Some tags may be misclassified as Operating Income.
concept_mappings._comment_aapl_other_income: AAPL reports 'OtherIncomeExpense' without 'Net' suffix, which is already handled in standardization.py

hierarchy_rules._comment: AAPL-specific hierarchy rules if needed. Currently handled by period-aware resolution.

business_context.description: Apple Inc. designs, manufactures, and markets smartphones, personal computers, tablets, wearables, and accessories worldwide
known_issues: Interest Income can be misclassified as Operating Income due to similar magnitude for cash-rich periods
Revenue concept changed from 'Revenues' to 'RevenueFromContractWithCustomer' in 2018
